newsitem.title: USA: American Bio now full reporting company.
newsitem.headline: American Bio now full reporting company.

text.p: American Bio Medica Corp said on Thursday its registration statement filed with the Securities & Exchange Commission to become a fully reporting company has become effective.
The biomedical company intends to file its first 10-Q following the close of its second quarter ending October 31.
American Bio Medica is a biomedical company which develops, manufactures and markets diagnostic kits for abused substance testing as well as other devices.
